My problem boiled down to being unable to get the normal "Find printer by other options" prompt. Every time I hit the "The printer I want isn't listed" when trying to install a new printer from the control panel, Win10 launched a website that described how to get the prompt to show, not the prompt itself. When I went to settings, clicked the + to add a printer, and then hit the "The printer I want isn't listed" link there, the right "Find printer by other options" prompt appeared and, now, if I click "The printer I want isn't listed" in the control panel, I get the prompt as well instead of the website.

So, a bit wordy and convoluted to basically say it fixed itself, but hopefully this helps anyone else who runs into the same frustrating problem.
I cannot figure out how to install a printer directly by IP on Win10. Any help is greatly appreciated!

Windows Key + X to open the system menu > Select Control Panel > Go to Devices and Printers > Select Add a Printer from the top menu > Quickly select "The printer that I want isn't listed" at the bottom of the window that is searching for devices > Select "Add a printer using TCP/IP address or hostname" > Select Next > Input the info and click Next.
